summary: mutateGraphQL must check payload-level errors (inside the single operation's own response object) in addition to top-level GraphQL errors, or a rejected mutation returns HTTP 200 with env.Errors empty and the CLI reports success.
reason: Forkable's mutation responses carry rejection reasons inside the operation's own payload (e.g. {"replacePiece": {"delivery": null, "errors": [...]}}), not in the GraphQL envelope's top-level errors array. Every mutation built in this file already requests "errors" in its selection set, so the fix is a single choke-point check in mutateGraphQL via the new payloadMutationErrors helper, applying uniformly to all 6 call sites without touching confirmOrPreview/emitMutationResult or the PRINTING_PRESS_VERIFY short-circuit.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/... -run TestPayloadMutationErrors covers errors:null, errors:[], string-array errors, object-array errors, an absent errors field, and non-object data; go build and the full test suite remain green.
